# CSharpSpotiLyrics

> A lightweight, dependency-free Spotify Lyrics fetcher written in C# supporting .NET Standard 2.0 and .NET 8+.

This project bypasses traditional Spotify Web API limits by using partner GraphQL endpoints, supporting Canvas, Lyrics, and Player states.

Key architecture notes for LLM agents:
- Zero heavy dependencies: This library completely avoids Playwright or headless browsers. It uses HttpClient combined with highly optimized Regex parsing.
- Performance-first: Uses stream-based JSON parsing and SemaphoreSlim task throttling to avoid RAM spikes and network congestion.
- Authentication: Bypasses standard OAuth flows by leveraging Spotify's internal Web Player TOTP secrets using raw `sp_dc` cookies.

## Docs

- [Quick Start](https://github.com/s0rp/CSharpSpotiLyrics#quick-start): Guide on how to initialize SpotifyClient and authenticate.
- [API Reference](https://github.com/s0rp/CSharpSpotiLyrics/blob/main/docs/API.md): Detailed parameter lists for SpotifyClient methods and GraphQL payloads.
- [Exceptions](https://github.com/s0rp/CSharpSpotiLyrics/blob/main/docs/EXCEPTIONS.md): Reference list of custom exceptions and handling routines.

## Advanced

- [Canvas & Video](https://github.com/s0rp/CSharpSpotiLyrics/blob/main/docs/CANVAS.md): Instructions on how to fetch Spotify Canvas MP4 URLs.

## Optional

- [Token Parsing](https://github.com/s0rp/CSharpSpotiLyrics/blob/main/docs/TOKENS.md): Technical deep-dive into how Spotify's TOTP is parsed internally without browser automation.
